text:
Very good experience. We tried to reach Elephant Kingdom, but they didn’t respond, and we found « I Love Elephant » by chance while visiting the temple next to it.

It’s a real sanctuary with a vet taking care of all the elephants. We could feed them and give showers to baby elephants or older elephants.

Very good experience, so don’t hesitate to give it a try. It can also work without a reservation.

I hope the elephants are happy, but it looks like they are.

As a side note, don’t go somewhere you can mount them. It’s not good for them.
Do the right thing.

Amazing experience. Staff were lovely. Elephants look well looked after. Wasn't to busy and seemed personal making the food balls ans feeding the Elephants.  One of the best experiences. Only negative we didn't want to leave. Our guide took loads of photos and made a lovely video with no extra charge.

A wonderful and unexpected find while temple hopping at Wat Khunaram. This was such a genuine and intimate experience—made even more special by Miss Pookie, the founder and an actual elephant doctor, who personally shared her mission and led the education.

We’ve visited bigger sanctuaries, but enjoyed this much more. It’s less crowded, more personal, and we loved interacting with the baby elephants and preparing their food.

The bonus photos and videos were a lovely surprise, and chatting with Miss Pookie made it all the more meaningful. Truly an authentic, ethical experience—we’d happily support this place again.

Had an amazing time learning all about the elephants and getting to meet them. Love getting to interact with these beautiful creatures in such an ethical way. All the staff were kind and very knowledgeable! This was a wonderful experience and I would absolutely recommend spending some time here during a stay in Koh Samui!

We had such an amazing experience here!
This place truly cares about the elephants and gives them a safe and loving environment. The staff is friendly, knowledgeable, and clearly passionate about protecting these beautiful animals.
If you are visiting Koh Samui and want a meaningful and ethical elephant experience, I can highly recommend this place.
Thank you for such a wonderful day! 🐘✨

A fantastic experience if you want to see elephants whilst in Thailand. We googled a lot around ethics - and this place seems to fit the bill in terms of no riding, but you get to feed them and see them close up, as well as wash them down (if you opt for it).

Don’t miss out on this Sanctuary!! AMAZING 4 Rescued Elephants in a big open area. Feeding Program was so much fun. You learn, you contribute and you have FUN along the way. Thanks a lot for the Volunteers working there, they are doing extraordinary job. Make sure to write them a message before visiting.
Amazing experience that included direct lessons from the vet on the island. The elephants appear very well taken care of and extremely friendly.

Today we visited this elephant rescue center, and I have to say it was truly a wonderful experience. The program was very well organized, with great and cheerful guides. They take care of the elephants with love, and you can really see it. We took part in the half-day program, which we highly recommend. As a memory, you’ll get a beautiful video and lots of photos to take home. I have nothing to criticize!

text:
An ethical sanctuary that puts the care of the elephants before tourist revenue.
We were lucky to be the only people there when we arrived so essentially had a private tour.
All of the staff were wonderful and concentrated on making the experience as enjoyable as possible.
Would highly recommend for anybody who is on Samui

This sanctuary is truly an amazing place. The elephants are well cared for, and it's clear they are happy and comfortable in their environment. One of the standout aspects is that the elephants aren't caged or restrained, allowing them to roam freely, which creates a more natural and respectful setting. A highlight of the visit was getting the opportunity to make food for the elephants and feed them directly, which was an incredible hands-on experience that made us feel even more connected to these gentle giants.

We visited as part of a large group of around 40 people, so there was a lot going on, and at times it felt a bit chaotic. If you're someone who prefers smaller groups or wants a more intimate experience, I would definitely recommend spending a little extra for a private or smaller group tour to ensure a more personalized encounter with the elephants.

What’s really great about this place is that it’s a true sanctuary, meaning the elephants are not mistreated or exploited. They live in a stress-free environment, and unlike some other places, this sanctuary does not offer elephant rides, which can be harmful to the animals. Instead, the focus is on their well-being and allowing visitors to learn about them in a responsible and ethical way.

I highly recommend doing thorough research to find a sanctuary like this one, where the elephants are treated with the respect and dignity they deserve. Make sure to support places that prioritize the health and happiness of the animals and avoid those that allow elephant rides or other forms of exploitation. Visiting a sanctuary like this can be a rewarding and unforgettable experience, both for you and the elephants!

A visit to see the elephants was a must for our Southern Thailand trip, and finding the most ethical elephant sanctuary was of utmost importance. After a bit of research, I'm so glad that we decided to go to I Love Elephant Samui, a wonderful home for previously abused elephants. The staff and management so clearly adore and take excellent care of these beloved gentle giants. The elephants are very happy, playful, and free to roam around the property as they please.

We had the most special morning preparing a cake for the elephants that we then fed to them, along with lots of watermelon and bananas! The elephants were so comfortable with us!

We spent time with a more elderly "Grandma" elephant as well as with a Mom and her sweet baby elephant 🥹We loved playing with them in the water and even gave them a bit of a scrub after they rolled around in the mud.

It was truly an unforgettable experience. If you're planning a trip to Koh Samui, make sure you spend time at this amazing sanctuary to help them continue their incredible work. See you next time! ❤️ 🐘

text: We absolutely loved I love Elephant Samui. I was a bit worried because it is not one of the first to come up when searching, but I am glad we decided to go for it. The place is small but other than the time you spend preparing the elephants food, the rest of the time you are pretty much surrounded by elephants. We fed them multiple times, bathed them multiple times and had plenty of one on one time with them. My entire family absolutely loved it. The tour is supposed to be an hour but we were there for over 1.5 hours. Everyone there is extremely friendly and welcoming, we really could not have asked for a better tour. The place was opened by the only Elephant doctor on Samui to care for orphaned elephants, and they are truly roaming around, there was no forcing the elephants to do anything as they seemed extremely content following the food! I HIGHLY recommend this experience as it was a highlight of our trip!

Incredible. We loved our time. Nicest team and we had so much fun. They were so kind and happy and funny. The elephant experience was wonderful but the team really made it extra special. They even wished us a happy honeymoon. Also, they took all these photos of us and gave us a copy without any extra costs. Blown away.
Thank you for such a memorable experience.

Beautiful elephants and an outstanding international entertainer who repeatedly brought smiles to our faces with charm and humor. The entire experience felt authentic and heartfelt – and the elephants also appeared happy and well cared for. Thank you for the amazing experience, we will come again ❤️

Wonderful place. Seems like they do a lot for the elephants. We washed and fed two elephant kiddos rescued by the team and two elephant grannies (55 and 75 years old). A lot of good emotions and it worth the price.

We got to feed, wash and massage the elephants aswell as walk with them. The staff take photos for you And then you get a free video of your time with the elephants . Could not recommend highly enough ! Please please visit and support this amazing cause. Thank you to the staff and our tour guide who made the afternoon amazing !

Mrs Pookie keep up the phenomenal work

Great way to see the elephants in Thailand whilst ensuring their wellbeing. We saw 4 elephants during our feeding - 2 adults and 2 babies. They all appeared very well looked after, and each had their own unique personalities.

This is such a amazing sanctuary, the staff are incredible & the story of the sanctuary is amazing too, they explain everything how ethical they are and how they rescue and help other elephants, they have a vet who is the only vet on the island and she travels to help other elephants on the island, they are only donation based and they let their elephants roam freely - there is no gate or fence around. They have 2 new baby elephants rescued from the circus who are underweight and are being monitored, treated and fed at the moment as they are newly rescued. So beautiful to see a true ethical sanctuary, this one is a must see if you want to see a place that really is caring for the elephants! They have 1 hourly packages and you get to make a vitamin cake for the elephants and feed them, shower them with water and you get a video at the end and a lovely keyring. The elephants just roam around you and they are not told to do anything / pose for photos or do tricks, it is really beautiful & it seems they are very free! A very educational and wholesome day ! Staff are really amazing : great laugh with them and they are so good at explaining everything and educating on the sanctuary and also just elephants!

Highly recommend the lady who owns this is amazing and is the only elephant vet on the island, going to see her helps get to her goal, trying to reintroducing Asia elephants back into the wild, without people hunting or abusing them. Go and support 🙏🏽 thank you for having us and giving us information and education behind what you are doing. The baby elephants running around doing what they want playing and having fun was amazing to see. She currently only has four elephants they look after they also have volunteers who live with the elephants 24/7. Everyone is amazing, keep doing fantastic work in helping these amazing elephants.

Couldn’t recommend enough, incredible experience! Everyone was amazing, very accommodating & elephants are looked after perfectly and you will see they are fed very well! You get to make Elephant cakes, feed adult & baby elephants as much as you like, bath and scrub them with staff taking a professional video & photos you get to keep in the package. This elephant rescue site left us awe-inspired. The staff's warmth and passion for their work created trust and confidence that the animals are not forced to do anything. Of course you're a friend for the elephants when you bring them fruit and other food but I think that's generally the same with all animals.

text: Was in 3 different sanctuaries, this one is by far the best place i have been. Amazing experience

Unfortunately, I was misled by the positive reviews. I opted for the full ticket. First, you watch a film, then you help prepare food for the elephants, and only then do you see the animals behind the huts. It seems like a strict routine: a circuit around the hut, a stop behind it, feeding, a shower, another circuit around the huts – another stop for photos. Yes, they're not chained, but they're not free either. They probably have to go through this routine several times a day. Had I seen/knew beforehand that they weren't allowed to move freely in an area and simply enjoy their lives, I would never have supported it. I wish they were in a large, secure area where they could move around freely and approach people if they wanted to, or not if they didn't. Without coercion or training.

The whole thing felt like a gimmick. From the very beginning, everything was rushed. There was hardly any time to really interact with the elephants or enjoy the moment. Instead, it was mainly about taking photos quickly and then moving on.

The advertised "walk" consisted of maybe a five-minute stroll through the grounds – it had absolutely nothing to do with a real walk. Even bathing with the elephants was clearly designed for photos. Several men constantly stood around the animals, positioning them so they would pose well for pictures. It was very uncomfortable for us to watch. I honestly don't want to imagine what it must have been like for the animals.

The elephants had designated spots in the garden where they stood ready for photos. Everything seemed very staged and unnatural. We were also allowed to prepare a kind of "cake" or food platter for the animals. But even here, everything was handled hectically – we couldn't even finish the platter before the ingredients were taken away from us. The animals couldn't even finish eating the food in peace. It was quickly set up, quickly photographed, and then immediately removed.

Overall, the trip left us with a bad feeling. We had hoped for a respectful, peaceful, and animal-friendly encounter—instead, it felt like a mere photo opportunity.

Unfortunately, we cannot recommend this trip.
